encounters.title: Lanterns on the Raft
encounters.flavor_text: At the landing, a flat raft circles without touching shore. Its ferryman keeps a lantern lit in broad daylight, watching the current as though it might change its mind. A stranded family waits behind Zuzu, too frightened to call across the water.

encounters.title: The Toll of Two Names
encounters.flavor_text: A registrar stops every traveler and writes down a name before permitting passage. On the open page, Zuzu sees the same pair of names repeated years apart, each in a different hand. No coin is requested, which makes the queue more uneasy.

encounters.title: The Boat That Waits
encounters.flavor_text: An empty skiff sits tied to a post long after the boats have departed. A boatwright says its owner promised to return before the flood, yet the water has fallen twice since. Every plank is sound except a splintered rudder.
